snippet.title: Rushmark Gameplay Trailer | Four Runs, One Lost By 0.2s
snippet.description:
Four complete runs, captured straight from the game with nothing cut out of them. Including the one that loses.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3560890/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer&utm_content=gameplay

Rushmark is a cyberpunk speedrunning platformer built on one refundable dash. Your dash is your weapon. Miss, and you wait. Kill, and you get it back instantly.

0:00 Course 2, a new personal best
0:15 Course 9, a whole course in under seven seconds
0:25 Course 6, one death, then losing it on the last section by two tenths
0:42 Survival, no finish line, it only gets faster

No commentary and no highlight editing. The splits and the result panels are the ones that came up on the day.

Ten handmade courses, Survival, three Marathon chains and a tutorial, with leaderboards, rival ghosts and downloadable replays. Season two adds five more courses after launch.

Out 27 October 2026 on Steam, made solo in Godot and C#. Coming to Google Play after launch. A wishlist genuinely helps a solo dev on launch day.

#indiegame #speedrun #platformer #pcgaming #gamedev #gaming #rushmark
